about_the_game:
In a world of shadow and steel, will you rise as a legend? Forge your destiny in Shinobi Unleashed, an MMORPG where you will master forbidden arts, battle epic foes, and carve your name into the annals of a living, breathing world. The path of the Shinobi is open. Will you walk it?

Explore the vast, 35+ square mile Land of Water, a sprawling archipelago of mystery and danger. From the bustling ports of coastal towns to the serene temples of hidden villages, every peak and valley holds a new challenge. Uncover the secrets of ancient mines, traverse untamed wilderness, and prove your strength in a world that is as beautiful as it is deadly.

Combat in Shinobi Unleashed is a fluid dance of steel and chakra. With a recent, comprehensive combat overhaul, you will experience unparalleled freedom of movement—from agile tree-hopping to swift swimming and precise hand signs. Command over 70 unique jutsus: summon meteors from the heavens, encase yourself in ethereal Rengoku ribcage armor, or thrust a ball of pure lightning into your enemies. Your arsenal is limited only by your will.

Defeat powerful S-Rank foes and world bosses to claim legendary scrolls and gear. Your progression is limitless as you build your shinobi over time. Engage in a player-driven economy where you can sell your spoils to vendors or trade directly with other players. Hunt for rare drops, master the markets, and equip yourself with the most powerful artifacts in the land.

A shinobi is strongest with their clan. Create lasting alliances by founding your own clan and appointing trusted allies to leadership ranks. For quicker adventures, seamlessly form a party with new friends using integrated Steam sessions. With global, clan, and party chat channels, strategic planning for raids and missions is always at your fingertips.

The Land of Water is not static. It evolves with dynamic, world-changing events. One day you may be defending the Hidden Village from a surprise invasion of S-Rank Rogue Shinobi for a chance at ultra-rare beta weapons; the next, you may be exploring a newly revealed dungeon. This is a world that lives and reacts, ensuring that your adventure is never the same.

Key Features:

  • A Massive 35+ Square Mile Open World: Explore the sprawling Land of Water and its many islands.

  • Over 70 Unique Jutsus: Master the elements, from devastating fire techniques to impenetrable earth walls.

  • Fluid Combat System: Experience a dynamic combat overhaul with tree-hopping, swimming, and detailed hand signs.

  • Deep Social Systems: Create clans with custom ranks or form parties for quick co-op play.

  • Player-Driven Economy: Trade gear and scrolls with vendors and other players.

  • Dynamic World Events: The world is constantly changing with new threats and opportunities.

  • Seamless Multiplayer: Fully functional Steam session integration to easily play with friends.

short_description: Forge your legend in Shinobi Unleashed, an open-world MMORPG. Experience a fluid combat system as you master over 70 devastating jutsus. Team up with friends in clans, hunt legendary foes for rare loot, and engage in a player-driven economy. Your path to becoming the ultimate shinobi awaits.
